storyCards.headline: Midnight At The Oasis: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Maria Muldaur's "Midnight At The Oasis" reached #6 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

Midnight At The Oasis was released in 1973.

"Midnight At The Oasis" by Maria Muldaur.

Chart story — peaked at #6 on the Hot 100.
